author: owned_signer_shape_review
preFreezeCorrections: Added independent-task actual awaited fixture cleanup because cancelled worker cannot call cancellation-checking Vault cleanup APIs. Outer cancellation still reaches and awaits the real worker/task.
CBC is decrypted without automatic padding then exact PKCS7 tail is validated before parsing, rather than trusting unspecified removal behavior.
Status ec accepts strict decimal string or typed integer as in actual original trusted-device response protocol; booleans/floats/malformed values reject.

M2 and negotiation MAC are mandatory before SPD parsing; exact XYZ/16-byte-IV/tag envelope and AES-GCM authentication are mandatory before candidate token extraction. Unknown password protocol and secondary-auth type reject.
The authenticated SPD app-token AES key accepts its valid 16/24/32-byte AES sizes, matching the original variable-key-length crypto primitive; SRP/CBC/session proofs remain SHA256/32-byte fixed.
Removed an invented maximum one-year expiry cap; actual positive finite future server expiry remains only a local refusal bound, followed by the existing live account/team checks before persistence.
boundaries: No password, OTP, idmsToken, session key or raw server body is logged/persisted by Auth. Only temporary pending 2FA state remains in memory, with one actual 300-second security-expiry task and explicit clearing barrier. Swift memory is not claimed to be securely zeroized.

Auth owns only password/2FA protocol state. Injected Account owns secure token record and injected existing Transport owns one URLSession. No duplicate Vault, keychain service, cookies, queue or token storage.

Client.connect is called only after complete authenticated protocol response and still validates actual developer identity plus original Personal Team before persisting. Candidate token/expiry do not establish Apple signing authority.

All server-selected work/data are bounded: fixed2048 group, 32-byte CSPRNG secret, serverB256, salt1..64, iteration1..1000000 with128-iteration cancellation checkpoints, 65536 encrypted blobs, existing1MiB network/plist budget.

Root AppSession actual Auth owner wiring remains a required integration action after this source review, with cancel/await before clearPendingAuthentication on close/logout/context discard. No Settings/UI/default provider is claimed.
unprovenProperties: No Swift SDK/typecheck, controlled URLProtocol peer, real Keychain or real Apple GSA execution yet.
Existing CryptoSwift BigUInteger exponentiation and AES-GCM implementation are general purpose; no constant-time/side-channel audit or secure-memory-erasure property is claimed.
Actual anisette provisioning/provider and real serial metadata remain absent. Missing deviceSerialNumber rejects rather than fabricating0.
Trusted-device 2FA only; SMS and unsupported newer secondary authentication states explicitly remain unsupported.
True account renewal, official issuer rotation/post-expiry enrollment and real-device automatic self-renewal remain unfinished.
